ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —

Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

accounting_quality.headline: Warning

reads.label: Earnings quality
reads.detail: accruals trending up over 6 fiscal years — earnings increasingly not cash-backed
reads.detail_zh: 应计利润在 6 个财年间走高——盈利的现金支撑减弱

reads.label: Working capital

reads.detail_zh: 营运资本与销售大致同步

accounting_quality.basis_zh: 多年趋势 + 同业排名
accounting_quality.caveat: Annual filings, lagged to the report date; free XBRL is sparse for some filers. Context, not a signal — it does not change the technical call.
accounting_quality.caveat_zh: 年度财报，滞后于披露日；免费 XBRL 数据对部分公司不全。仅供参考，并非交易信号，不改变技术面判断。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

gex_confirm.label: Options caution

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (22) — mechanical resistance overhead
reasons.zh: 接近 Call 墙（22）约 1σ 以内 — 上方有机械阻力

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up
reasons.zh: 在上沿 Gamma 带蓄势 — 收盘突破即向上释放

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

trust_tier.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust_tier.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡
